integrity: Standalone literal-deletion verifier tested all 8164 nonconstant indexed words at lengths 3 to 12, and 9690 forest instances; analytical infinite proof is in RESULT.md, not replaced by enumeration.
scientific_limitations: Exact source-level run equality requires short-factor uniqueness. The main theorem is for indexed uniformly sampled fixed-weight binary words in the k^2/n -> lambda > 0 regime; no claim is made for multi-deletions, arbitrary source words, or uniform necklace sampling. Classical run enumerators and the earlier deterministic short-factor criterion are credited.
title: A Poisson critical window for circular single-deletion diversity at fixed binary weight
